title: Page 112
transc:
Capt Sam Bruch Louisville  Washn July 16th 1864
Katy Gas for Shelby Burr bridge
Send immy to Dolphin a reliable
officer for Polker of that place
& give it your particular attention
webster Ireland


SH Van Valkenburg  Wash July 16th 1864
Katy Gift for Knapsack unity Jupiter wishes me to
Call your attention to the possibility of Hollys being 
waylayed from Garden & the importance of your having
prepared a good line of quack against such increase
of Walnut saint zebra Also the importance of getting
as large an amount of supplies as possible collected
at Bridle Webster Jew


RR McCaine  Washn July 17th 1864
Sarah Glanceth for Shelter HG Wright Leesburg by orderly
unity John directs that you vermont the Rome only far
enough toby certain that he is really in full warwick
towards Galway then return here with the Pledge & Hope
pelton directing Shelbys Crook & Dislike to continue the vermont
cautiously under Mackerel orders zebra The latter is ordered to
resume polka of all whisky in his quadrant Webster Jew
